purpose: Execute the already-defined E02 L0-L11 vertical-topology claim against one complete same-line chain, its indexed closure, one append-only relation-version transition, the L12 boundary and the level-derived-authority boundary. This record mirrors the active E2.0 trace matrix and does not create or expand a product contract.

implementation_basis.role: Production Node and append-only NodeRelation model
Production NodeClosure maintenance and shared context/scope resolvers
Production same-line active-parent and immediately preceding-level write guard
Shared TypeScript topology parser and relation-history validation
Single production adapter path for context, self, ancestors, descendants and subtree

regression_basis.role: Existing full L0-L11 model, version-history, skip-level, cross-line, dual-parent and L12 regression

environment_classification: A successful clean-source replay of all production migrations in a disposable PostgreSQL 17 environment followed by the complete locked E02 matrix can establish DEV VERIFIED only. It is not a stable staging or production observation.
prelocked_thresholds: node count = 12, current parent-edge count = 11 and L12 fact count = 0
all 12 levels use one Node table, one NodeRelation table, one NodeClosure table and the same context/scope resolver functions
all 11 parent edges are same-line and connect each L1-L11 node to the immediately preceding level
current closure row count = 78; self total = 12; ancestor total = 66; descendant total = 66; subtree total = 78
independently derived closure and all per-level resolver result mismatch counts = 0
V-L6 relation version count = 2 with one preserved historical interval and one current interval
historical and current path reconstruction mismatch counts = 0
skip-level, second-parent, cross-line and L12 probes are all rejected and leave zero residual facts
permission, sovereignty and sovereign-resource changes caused solely by signed_level each = 0
negative oracle mutation detection miss count = 0
positive_cases: Create V-L0 through V-L11 through the shared Node and NodeRelation model and resolve NodeContext at every level.
Resolve self, ancestors, descendants and subtree through the same four production functions at every level.
Append relation version 2 for V-L6 without overwriting version 1, then reconstruct the path for both effective intervals.
negative_cases: Attempt an L8 to L6 skip-level relation.
Attempt a second current relation for an existing node.
Attempt a parent edge to a node on another line.
Attempt to create an L12 relation and verify that no L12 fact remains.
Compare explicit access, sovereignty and sovereign-resource facts before and after signed-level relations are written.

independent_oracle.procedure: Read the locked criteria and required raw artifacts only; derive the expected L0-L11 parent map and both effective-interval paths directly from raw relation rows; derive all expected closure pairs and per-level self, ancestors, descendants and subtree results independently; compare model/path catalog facts, negative probe errors, residual counters, L12 facts and level-derived authority counters; mutate copies of the closure, relation history and negative-probe records to prove detection. Do not consume a runner PASS/status field.

unknown_rule: Missing any level, parent-edge interval, complete closure row, per-level resolver result, relation-version row, historical path, negative probe, L12 count, authority counter, environment fact or source-basis digest yields UNKNOWN.

outcome_table.condition: All required raw artifacts exist and all prelocked topology, model/path, closure, relation-version, boundary, authority and mutation-detection thresholds are met.
Any complete raw observation contradicts a prelocked topology, closure, version, boundary or authority threshold.
Any required raw artifact or field is missing, unreadable or cannot be independently reconciled.

review_classification: The criteria designer, executor and oracle operator are the same Codex task; the result remains NOT REVIEWED until a reviewer independent of the E02 topology implementation and test code recomputes and signs it.
